text: Smoke reported on the 4th floor, 1801 Century Park, Los Angeles. Time of call: Saturday 15:00.

out.briefing:
PRIMESIGHT | SMOKE INVESTIGATION | FLOOR 4 | Century Park East, 1801 Century Park E, Los Angeles, CA
ABOVE FIRE: ~668 people on floors 5-25 by daytime headcount. Call Sat 15:00, so likely far fewer on site. Fl 7 Mediapro Studios: possible production gear (from name only)
ON FLOOR: ~57 by daytime headcount (Sat, likely fewer). Ste 450 Bluefox Entertainment, ste 460 Bruin Biometrics (possible electronics/batteries, from name only), ste 470 Wiesman Pirian Law, ste 475 Structure Law Group, ste 490 Simple House Films + unknown tenant
WATER/WIND: 12 hydrants within 300 m, nearest 33-37 m N, ~70 m W, 72 m SE. Wind from ENE 7 mph (gusts 9), smoke drifts WSW, 59F
INSIDE: 3D scan of this floor, 41 scan points. EXIT SIGNS seen from 25 of 41 points (not stair locations). Walk from scan start: exit sign ~6 m, far end ~18 m. No pull station seen at any point
BUILDING: 25 stories, built 1972, steel frame, sprinklers yes. 8 passenger elevators, 1 freight
ROOF: membrane, 8 vents, 2 skylights. OPEN LOT for staging ~110 m SE (aerial search, verify)
FLOOR 1: Up Fitness, possible gym, may be busy Sat afternoon (from name only)
PROPERTY MGR: Douglas Emmett - Century Park Plaza 5550856585 (texted to meet crew)
NOT KNOWN: sprinkler type, stair locations, standpipe locations
SCAN: https://my.matterport.com/show/?m=gacELDAHQEZ
